entities.speaker: Julie Bleazard
entities.comment-context: Public hearing on short-term rental ordinance

segments.text: May 14, 2019 — As recorded in the meeting minutes:

, resident, commented she had lived in American Fork for six years. She said she loved her neighborhood but did not like the short-term rentals. She said this scared her because she did not know who was living in these homes. She thanked the Council for investigating this issue. She noted she understood why people needed to rent out their homes. She said it was good they were making an ordinance so the police could act on problems.
